resources.name: iFixit — repair learning and device research
resources.description: Free repair and electronics reference material. Beginners can study component diagrams without opening their device; exact-model repair coverage and firmware compatibility are not established by a general guide.
resources.audience: Beginner learning, device research and safe reuse planning. A guide or easy difficulty rating is not approval for a minor to service equipment.
resources.practicalAction: Record the model and condition externally, read Device Safety, then name three components and their functions from the linked diagram guide. Do not open an unknown synthesizer. Mains circuits, stored-charge capacitors, CRTs and damaged batteries require a qualified technician; an adult without relevant competence is not a substitute.
resources.verification: Official Electronics Skills, Device Safety and Identifying Major Electronic Components pages read on November 15, 2026. This verifies reference content, not any instrument compatibility, repair result, professional supervision or product availability.
resources.fees: Reading the referenced guides is free. Tools, parts, connectivity, professional supervision and workshop access can cost money; no purchase is required for the reading activity.
resources.availability: Public reading; no account needed for this starter exercise. Read current age, guardian-consent and licensing terms before posting or reusing content. No hardware work, public post or funding application occurs here.

resources.name: Xsens — animation contest 2026
resources.description: Commercial motion-capture opportunity: work with supplied performance data without buying a suit. A contest is not employment, a grant or an accommodation. Deadline: 10 December 2026, 23:59 GMT (recheck). No generative AI for submitted characters, environments, animation or final imagery. No contest-data redistribution, use outside the competition, or AI training/fine-tuning/evaluation. Ordinary denoising, upscaling and motion cleanup are permitted when the creative work is yours.
resources.jurisdiction: International; export restrictions and local law apply
resources.verification: Verified official page and terms v2.5 (15 September 2026), checked 15 November 2026. Deadline: 10 December 2026, 23:59 GMT. Recheck before entry.
resources.fees: Free entry; creation, hosting, tax and import costs remain yours. Any 3D package is allowed; compatible tools and accessible workflow must be verified.
resources.availability: Individuals/teams; minors require guardian acceptance. Export-restricted places and specified organiser/jury/sponsor relationships are excluded. No acceptance or prize guaranteed.
resources.practicalAction: No generative AI for submitted characters, environments, animation or final imagery. Ordinary denoising, upscaling and motion cleanup are permitted when the creative work is yours. No redistribution, use outside the contest, or AI training/fine-tuning/evaluation of contest data or derivatives. Finished-entry portfolio display is permitted; raw-data reuse is not. Read promotional rights before registering; no automatic entry here.
